decisive_items: Tumors positive for GATA3, tyrosine hydroxylase, chromogranin A, and synaptophysin
response.rationale: SDHB pathogenic variant with catecholamine-secreting paraganglioma/pheochromocytoma-type pathology establishes hereditary paraganglioma-pheochromocytoma syndrome; more specific tumor-only labels omit the germline syndrome or pheochromocytoma component.

rejected.why: Pheochromocytoma is only one component and does not account for SDHB germline variant or extra-adrenal paraganglioma history.
Correctly identifies SDHB-related paraganglioma but is narrower than the syndrome and omits the pheochromocytoma component.
Paraganglioma alone misses the SDHB hereditary syndrome and pheochromocytoma component.
Neuroendocrine tumor is too broad; S100 sustentacular cells and SDHB specify paraganglioma/pheochromocytoma.
SDHB variant is not associated with multiple endocrine neoplasia; no RET/MEN1 evidence or other MEN features.
Contradicted by normal PSA and neuroendocrine/S100-positive, cytokeratin-negative pathology.
Hypertension is a symptom, not the underlying diagnosis.
